description.zh: 发信地址。不填，代表所有地址。
description.en: The sender address. If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all sender addresses are returned.

description.zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP的数据。

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据。
description.en:
If you use Dedicated IPs, use this parameter to filter statistics by a specific Dedicated IP.

If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all dedicated IPs that match the other criteria are returned.

description.zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的独立IP池ID的数据

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据。
description.en:
If you use Dedicated IPs, specify the ID of the dedicated IP pool to query.

If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all resources are returned.

description.zh: 结束时间，和起始时间跨度不能超出7天，格式yyyy-MM-dd。
description.en: The end time for the query. The time range between `StartTime` and `EndTime` cannot exceed 7 days. The format must be `YYYY-MM-DD`.

description.zh:
对于独立IP用户，查询特定的ESP数据的数据，可以填写的值如下
- gmail.com
- yahoo.com
- outlook.com
- icloud.com
- others（对应其他的非上述ESP的数据）

不填写此参数时默认查询所有数据。
description.en:
If you use Dedicated IPs, use this parameter to filter statistics by a specific Email Service Provider (ESP). Valid values are:

- `gmail.com`

- `yahoo.com`

- `outlook.com`

- `icloud.com`

- `others` (matches data for all other ESPs)

If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all ESPs are returned.

description.zh: 起始时间，时间不能早于30日，格式yyyy-MM-dd
description.en: The start time for the query. The date cannot be more than 30 days in the past. The format must be `YYYY-MM-DD`.

description.zh: 邮件标签。不填，代表所有标签。
description.en: The email tag. If you do not specify this parameter, statistics for all tags are returned.

title.zh: 获取指定条件下的发送数据
title.en: Retrieve the send data under specified conditions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun dm sender-statistics-by-tag-name-and-batch-id --account-name xxx --start-time 2019-09-29 --end-time 2019-09-29 --tag-name xxx --dedicated-ip-pool-id xxx --dedicated-ip xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx --esp gmail.com --domain dmdomain.com --api-version 2015-11-23 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun dm SenderStatisticsByTagNameAndBatchID --region cn-hangzhou --DedicatedIpPoolId xxx --Esp 'gmail.com' --EndTime '2019-09-29' --TagName xxx --DedicatedIp 'xxx.xxx.xxx.xxx' --StartTime '2019-09-29' --Domain 'dmdomain.com' --AccountName xxx
